_comment: TTS-only respellings for Grades R-3 phonics lines (voice_batch/r3_lines.py). Key: the app's R3Line key (by_key) or an exact line text (by_text); value: what the voice is asked to say instead, so it says the letter SOUND, never the letter NAME. The display text in the pack never changes. Lines rendered from a respelling are ASR-checked against this text and flagged needs_listen in the manifest. Draft: sounds are spelled ah (a as in ant), aw (o as in on), ih (i as in insect), mmm, sss, and a short 'uh' after the stops and v/j/n/w (buh, duh, guh, juh, kuh, nuh, vuh, wuh).

by_key.english_home_language.grade2.term4.w10_r: You know so many sounds now! Let's build words with all of them. fff-lll-ah-guh. Flag! Shark, train, coin, bird.
Listen. kuh-rrr-ah-buh. Push the sounds together. What word is it?
Listen. sss-puh-aw-tuh. What word is it?
You caught me! I left out rrr. My tiles say fog.
Let's build it together. fff-rrr-aw-guh. Frog!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term1.w01_c: Clap the parts. Croc, aw, dile. How many parts?
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term1.w01_f: Every word starts with a sound. Sun starts with sss. Mat starts with mmm. Listen for the first sound!
Which one starts with sss, as in sun?
Which one starts with mmm, as in mat?
Which one starts with tuh, as in tap?
Does it start with sss or mmm? Put each picture in its group.
You caught me! Moon starts with mmm. Mmm, mmm, moon.
Let's listen together. Mmmoon. Moon starts with mmm!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term1.w02_l: Three letters! This is sss. Sss, sss, snake. This is ah. Ah, ah, apple. This is tuh. Tuh, tuh, tap.
Sss is curly like a snake. Tuh is tall with a cross. Ah is round.
Tap the letter that says sss.
Tap the letter that says tuh.
This letter says ah. Say the sound!
Sam starts with sss. Tap the first letter of Sam.
My turn! I will find the letter that says tuh.
This one! The curly one says tuh.
You caught me! The curly letter says sss. Tuh is the tall one with a cross.
Let's look together. Tall with a cross. That is tuh!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term1.w03_s: Sun and sock start the same. Sss, sss. Sun and mat start differently. Sss and mmm. Listen!
Moon! It starts with mmm, not sss.
Tap, tent. Both start with tuh.
Which one does not start with ah?
You caught me! Sun and sock both start with sss. The same!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term1.w04_s: New sounds! Puh, puh, pig. Ih, ih, insect. Nuh, nuh, net. Let's find them.
Listen for the first sound. Puh, puh, pig.
Puh pops from your lips. Nuh hums in your nose.
Which one starts with puh, as in pig?
Tap the letter that says nuh.
Say the sound with me. Ih, as in insect!
Which one starts with nuh, as in net?
Which one starts with ih, as in insect?
What is this? It starts with puh.
Does it start with puh or nuh? Sort the pictures.
My turn! I will find a word that starts with nuh.
You caught me! Pig starts with puh. Net starts with nuh.
Let's listen together. Nuh, nuh, net. Net starts with nuh!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term1.w04_w: Let's write our letters. Sss curls like a snake. Ah goes round, then down. Watch and trace!
Trace sss with your finger. Start at the top, curl one way, then the other.
Trace ah with your finger. Go round, then a line down.
Tap the letter that says tuh.
Trace tuh with your finger. A tall line down, then a cross.
Trace puh with your finger. A long line down, back up, then round.
Puh hangs its tail below the line.
My turn! I will write tuh.
You caught me! I forgot the cross. That is not tuh yet.
Let's fix it together. Tall line down, then a cross. Now it is tuh!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term1.w06_b: Sounds make words! Ah, tuh. at. Put sss in front. Sss, at. Sat! Let's build words.
Say each sound, then push them together. Mmm, ah, tuh. Mat.
Listen. Mmm, ah, tuh. What word is it?
Listen. Puh, ah, tuh. Tap the word.
Put sss in front of at. What word do you make?
Listen. Tuh, ah, puh. What word is it?
Put mmm in front of at. What word do you make?
My turn! Sss, ah, tuh. I will say the word.
You caught me! Sss, ah, tuh says sat, not mat.
Let's push the sounds together. Sss, ah, tuh. Sat!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term1.w06_s: Two more sounds! Mmm, mmm, mat. Duh, duh, dog. Can you hear them?
Listen for the first sound. Mmm hums. Duh taps.
Mmm has two humps. Duh has a round tummy and a tall back.
Which one starts with duh, as in dog?
Tap the letter that says mmm.
Say the sound with me. Duh, as in dog!
Which one starts with mmm, as in mat?
Trace duh with your finger. Round first, then a tall line up and down.
Trace mmm with your finger. Down, then up and over, up and over.
Does it start with mmm or duh? Sort the pictures.
My turn! I will find the letter that says duh.
This one with two humps says duh!
You caught me! Two humps is mmm. Duh has a tall back.
Let's look together. Round tummy, tall back. That is duh!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term1.w08_b: Blend the sounds! Kuh, ah, tuh. Cat! Sss, ih, tuh. Sit! Listen and blend.
Say the sounds slowly, then fast. Kuh, ah, tuh. Cat!
Listen. Kuh, ah, tuh. What word is it?
Listen. Puh, ih, nuh. Tap the word.
Sss, ih, tuh. Blend the sounds. What word is it?
Listen. Tuh, ih, nuh. What word is it?
Duh, ah, duh. Blend the sounds. Who is it?
You caught me! Mmm, ah, tuh is mat. Cat starts with kuh.
Let's blend together. Mmm, ah, tuh. Mat!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term1.w08_s: Let's look together. Ih, sss. That card says is!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term1.w08_v: Ah and ih are vowels. Every word needs one! Cat has ah. Pin has ih. Listen in the middle.
Ah opens your mouth wide. Ih is a small smile.
Which word has ah in the middle? Listen. Cat, pin.
Which word has ih in the middle? Listen. Sat, sit.
Ah in the middle, or ih in the middle? Sort the words.
The vowel in pin is ah!
You caught me! Puh, ih, nuh. The vowel is ih.
Let's say it slowly. Piiin. The middle sound is ih!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term1.w10_w: Let's show what we know! Blend the sounds, build the words. Sss, ah, duh. Sad!
Listen. Nuh, ah, puh. What word is it?
Listen. Duh, ih, puh. Tap the word.
Change the mmm in mat to sss. What word do you make?
Listen. Mmm, ah, puh. What word is it?
My turn! I will read this word. Nuh, ah, puh.
You caught me! Nuh, ah, puh is nap. Pan starts with puh.
Let's blend together. Nnn, ah, puh. Nap!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term2.w01_s: Words break into sounds! Hop. Huh, aw, puh. Three sounds. Let's pull words apart.
Tap a finger for each sound. Huh, aw, puh.
Say the sounds in sun. Sss, uh, nuh. How many sounds?
Three sounds! Sss, uh, nuh.
Two sounds! Ah, tuh.
Which word has these sounds? Duh, aw, guh.
Dog! Duh, aw, guh.
Kuh, ah. Two sounds!
You caught me! Kuh, ah, tuh. Three sounds.
Let's tap them together. Kuh, ah, tuh. Three!
New sounds! Huh, huh, hat. Aw, aw, octopus. Guh, guh, goat. Listen for them.
Listen for the first sound. Huh is a little puff of air.
Guh comes from the back of your throat. Guh, guh.
Which one starts with huh, as in hat?
Huh, huh, hen.
Tap the letter that says guh.
Yes! That is guh.
Say the sound with me. Aw, as in octopus!
Which one starts with guh, as in goat?
Guh, guh, gate.
Which word has aw in the middle? Listen. Hot, hat.
Hot! Huh, aw, tuh.
Trace huh with your finger. Tall line down, then up and over the hump.
Does it start with huh or guh? Sort the pictures.
My turn! I will find a word that starts with guh.
Hat! Hat starts with guh.
You caught me! Hat starts with huh. Goat starts with guh.
Let's listen together. Guh, guh, goat. Goat starts with guh!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term2.w02_e: Words have a first sound and a last sound. Dog starts with duh, ends with guh. Listen to the end!
Stretch it out. Caaat. Hear the tuh?
Which one ends with nuh, as in sun?
Which one ends with puh, as in hop?
Goat, hat. Both end with tuh.
Does the word end with tuh or guh? Sort the pictures.
You caught me! Pig starts with puh. It ends with guh.
Let's say it slowly. Piiig. The last sound is guh!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term2.w02_w: Listen. Huh, aw, tuh. What word is it?
Listen. Mmm, aw, puh. Tap the word.
Change the huh in hot to puh. What word do you make?
Tall letters, small letters, letters with tails. Huh is tall. Aw is small. Guh has a tail. Let's write!
Trace aw with your finger. Start at the top and go round.
Trace guh with your finger. Go round, then down and curl the tail.
Trace nuh with your finger. Down, then up and over the hump.
Trace huh with your finger. Tall line down, up, then over the hump.
My turn! I will write nuh.
You caught me! I made it tall. That is huh. Nuh is small.
Let's look together. A small hump, not tall. That is nuh!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term2.w04_r: You caught me! Mmm, ah, tuh. The cat is on the mat.
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term2.w04_w: Listen to the middle sound. Ah or eh?
Listen. Puh, ah, nuh. What word is it?
Listen. Huh, eh, nuh. Tap the word.
Change the puh in pen to tuh. What word do you make?
You caught me! Puh, eh, nuh is pen. Pan has ah in the middle.
Let's blend together. Puh, eh, nuh. Pen!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term2.w06_o: Split a word in two! Huh, en. Hen. Puh, en. Pen. Hen and pen rhyme!
The first sound, then the rest. Huh, en.
Listen. Tuh, in. What word is it?
Buh, ug. Put them together. What word is it?
Listen. Mmm, ug. Tap the word.
You caught me! Puh, in is pin. Pen has en.
Let's put them together. Puh, in. Pin!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term2.w06_s: More sounds! Kuh, kuh, cat. Kuh, kuh, kite. Eh, eh, egg. Uh, uh, umbrella.
Kuh and kuh make the same sound. Look at the letter shape.
Eh and uh are vowels. Listen in the middle of the word.
Which one starts with kuh, as in kite?
Kuh, kuh, king.
Say the sound with me. Uh, as in umbrella!
Which word has eh in the middle? Listen. Pen, pin.
Pen! Puh, eh, nuh.
Which one starts with kuh, as in cat?
Kuh, kuh, cup.
Which word has uh in the middle? Listen. Bus, bat.
Bus! Buh, uh, sss.
Trace eh with your finger. Across, then up and round.
Does it start with kuh or kuh? Sort the pictures.
The vowel in bus is eh!
You caught me! Buh, uh, sss. The vowel is uh.
Let's say it slowly. Buuus. The middle sound is uh!
Word magic! Hop. Change huh to mmm. Mop! Change aw to ah. Map! Swap one sound, new word.
Cat. Change kuh to huh. What word do you make?
Pin. Change ih to ah. Tap the new word.
Pan! Puh, ah, nuh.
Dog. Change duh to huh. What word do you make?
Hot. Change tuh to puh. Tap the new word.
Hop! Huh, aw, puh.
Pet. Change eh to aw. Listen. Puh, aw, tuh. What word is it?
Bug. Change buh to mmm. What word do you make?
My turn! Cat. I will change kuh to mmm.
You caught me! Kuh to mmm makes mat, not bat.
Let's swap together. Take away kuh, put in mmm. Mat!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term2.w08_s: Four sounds! Rrr, rrr, rat. Lll, lll, leg. Buh, buh, bus. Fff, fff, fan.
Listen for the first sound. Rrr growls. Lll sings.
Fff blows air through your teeth. Buh pops.
Which one starts with rrr, as in rat?
Which one starts with lll, as in leg?
Say the sound with me. Fff, as in fan!
Tap the letter that says buh.
Yes! Buh has a tall back and a round tummy.
Bat. Change buh to rrr. What word do you make?
Trace fff with your finger. Curl at the top, go down, then across.
Does it start with rrr, lll, buh or fff? Sort the pictures.
My turn! I will find a word that starts with lll.
You caught me! Rat starts with rrr. Leg starts with lll.
Let's listen together. Lll, lll, leg. Leg starts with lll!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term2.w10_s: Listen. Rrr, uh, guh. What word is it?
Leg. Change lll to puh. What word do you make?
Bus ends with sss, not guh.
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term3.w01_s: Four sounds! Juh, juh, jam. Vuh, vuh, van. Wuh, wuh, web. Yuh, yuh, yoyo.
Listen for the first sound. Juh jumps. Vuh buzzes.
Wuh is one point down twice. Vuh is one point.
Which one starts with juh, as in jam?
Juh, juh, jug.
Which one starts with wuh, as in web?
Wuh, wuh, wig.
Say the sound with me. Vuh, as in van!
Which one starts with yuh, as in yoyo?
Yuh, yuh, yak.
Tap the letter that says vuh.
Yes! Vuh has one point.
Does it start with juh, vuh, wuh or yuh? Sort the pictures.
My turn! I will find a word that starts with vuh.
Web! Web starts with vuh.
You caught me! Web starts with wuh. Van starts with vuh.
Let's listen together. Vuh, vuh, van. Van starts with vuh!
The last sounds! Kwuh, kwuh, queen. Zzz, zzz, zip. Ks is at the end. Fox. Box.
Kwuh always has uh with it. Queen, quilt.
Ks is a sound at the end. Fox, box, six.
Which one starts with kwuh, as in queen?
Kwuh, kwuh, quilt.
Which one starts with zzz, as in zip?
Zzz, zzz, zebra.
Which one ends with ks, as in fox?
Six ends with ks.
Say the sound with me. Zzz, as in zip!
Tap the letter that says kwuh.
Yes! Kwuh has a tail that flicks out.
Starts with kwuh, starts with zzz, or ends with ks? Sort the pictures.
Box ends with sss!
You caught me! Box ends with ks. Bo, ks.
Let's say it slowly. Boxxx. The last sound is ks!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term3.w02_t: Three letters, one word! Juh, eh, tuh. Jet! Wuh, ih, guh. Wig! Build them with me.
Listen. Juh, eh, tuh. What word is it?
Listen. Vuh, ah, nuh. Tap the word.
Build it. Zzz, ih, puh. What word is it?
Listen. Yuh, ah, kuh. What word is it?
You caught me! Wuh, eh, buh is web.
Let's blend together. Wuh, eh, buh. Web!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term3.w02_w: Capital letters are big and tall. Small sss, capital Sss. Same sound, bigger shape. Let's write them!
Trace the capital Sss. Curl one way, then the other, big and tall.
Trace the capital Tuh. A tall line down, then a line across the top.
Which is the capital that matches small mmm?
Yes! Capital Mmm has two mountains.
Trace the capital Ah. Up to the point, down, then a line across.
Which is the capital that matches small duh?
Capital Duh. A line and a big curve.
Trace the capital Mmm. Down, up to the point, down to the point, up.
My turn! I will write the capital Tuh.
You caught me! That is a small tuh. A capital Tuh is tall with the line on top.
Let's make it tall. Line down, line across the top. Capital Tuh!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term3.w04_l: Two sounds stuck together! Bluh, bluh, black. Fluh, fluh, flag. Sluh, sluh, slip. Blends!
Say both sounds fast. Buh, lll. Bluh!
Which one starts with fluh, as in flag?
Listen. Sluh, ih, puh. What word is it?
Say the blend with me. Bluh, as in black!
Which one starts with kluh, as in clap?
Listen. Fluh, ah, guh. Tap the word.
Does it start with bluh, fluh or sluh? Sort the pictures.
My turn! I will find a word that starts with sluh.
You caught me! Flag starts with fluh. Slide starts with sluh.
Let's listen together. Sluh, sluh, slide. Slide starts with sluh!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term3.w04_r: More blends! Fruh, fruh, frog. Druh, druh, drum. Gruh, gruh, grass. Listen for the rrr.
Say both sounds fast. Fff, rrr. Fruh!
The second sound is rrr. Hear it growl.
Which one starts with fruh, as in frog?
Listen. Druh, uh, mmm. What word is it?
Say the blend with me. Gruh, as in grass!
Which one starts with kruh, as in crab?
Listen. Fruh, aw, guh. Tap the word.
Does it start with fruh, druh or gruh? Sort the pictures.
You caught me! I forgot the rrr. Druh, uh, mmm. Drum!
Let's blend together. Drr, uh, mmm. Drum!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term3.w06_d: Two letters, one sound! Sss and huh together say shh. Shh, shh, ship. Quiet like a library!
Shh is the quiet sound. Finger on your lips. Shh!
Sss and huh together make one new sound.
Which one starts with shh, as in ship?
Shh, shh, shop.
Say the sound with me. Shh, as in ship!
Listen. Shh, eh, ll. What word is it?
Shell! Shh, eh, ll.
Tap the letters that say shh.
Sss and huh together say shh.
Which one does not start with shh?
Sun starts with just sss.
Does it start with shh or just sss? Sort the pictures.
My turn! I will find a word that starts with shh.
Sock! Sock starts with shh.
You caught me! Sock starts with sss. Ship starts with shh.
Let's listen together. Shh, shh, ship. Ship starts with shh!
Two more! Kuh and huh say chuh. Chuh, chuh, chip. Tuh and huh say thh. Thh, thh, thumb.
Chuh is like a sneeze. Thh puts your tongue between your teeth.
Which one starts with chuh, as in chip?
Chuh, chuh, chair.
Which one starts with thh, as in thumb?
Thh, thh, three.
Say the sound with me. Chuh, as in chip!
Listen. Chuh, ih, nuh. What word is it?
Chin! Chuh, ih, nuh.
Tap the letters that say thh.
Tuh and huh together say thh.
Does it start with shh, chuh or thh? Sort the pictures.
My turn! I will find a word that starts with thh.
Chip! Chip starts with thh.
You caught me! Chip starts with chuh. Thumb starts with thh.
Let's listen together. Thh, thh, thumb. Thumb starts with thh!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term4.w01_d: Remember our two-letter sounds? Shh, shh, ship. Chuh, chuh, chip. Thh, thh, thin. Let's find them again!
Shh is quiet. Chuh is a sneeze. Thh is tongue between teeth.
Listen. Shh, ih, puh. What word is it?
Listen. Chuh, ih, puh. Tap the word.
Does it start with shh, chuh or thh? Sort the pictures.
You caught me! Shh, aw, puh is shop. Chop starts with chuh.
Let's blend together. Shh, aw, puh. Shop!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term4.w02_b: Blends that start with sss! Spuh, spuh, spot. Stuh, stuh, stick. Snuh, snuh, snap.
Start with sss, then the next sound fast. Sss, tuh. Stuh!
Listen to the second sound. Puh, tuh or nuh?
Listen. Spuh, aw, tuh. What word is it?
Which one starts with stuh, as in stick?
Say the blend with me. Snuh, as in snap!
Listen. Stuh, eh, puh. Tap the word.
Which one starts with spuh, as in spot?
Does it start with spuh, stuh or snuh? Sort the pictures.
My turn! I will find a word that starts with stuh.
You caught me! Snail starts with snuh. Star starts with stuh.
Let's listen together. Stuh, stuh, star. Star starts with stuh!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term4.w02_s: Spelling time! Say the word, hear the sounds, write the letters. Ship. Shh, ih, puh.
Two-letter sounds need both letters. Shh, chuh, thh.
Listen. Thh, ih, nuh. Which word is it?
You caught me! Chip starts with chuh, not shh.
Let's hear the start. Chuh, chuh, chip. Kuh, huh first!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term4.w04_d: Two-letter sounds at the end too! Fi, shh. Fish! Mu, chuh. Much! Wi, thh. With!
Fish ends in shh, like a quiet sound at the end.
Which one ends with shh, as in fish?
Listen. Buh, ah, thh. What word is it?
Which one ends with chuh, as in much?
Does it end with shh, chuh or thh? Sort the pictures.
You caught me! Bath ends with thh. Ba, thh.
Let's say it slowly. Baaath. The last sound is thh!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term4.w06_p: One cat, two cats. Add sss for more than one! One dish, two dishes. After shh and chuh, add es.
More than one? Add sss at the end.
If the word ends in shh, chuh, sss or ks, add es.
Dishes! After shh we add es.
Add sss, or add es? Sort the words.
You caught me! Box ends in ks, so we add es. Boxes.
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term4.w08_b: All our sounds together! Blends like fruh and spuh. Digraphs like shh and chuh. Read anything!
Blends keep both sounds. Fruh, spuh, stuh.
Digraphs make one new sound. Shh, chuh, thh.
Listen. Fruh, eh, shh. What word is it?
Listen. Chuh, aw, puh. Tap the word.
You caught me! Stuh, aw, puh is stop. Shop starts with shh.
Let's blend together. Stt, aw, puh. Stop!
by_key.english_home_language.grade1.term4.w10_w: Listen. Juh, uh, mp. What word is it?
Ship. Change shh to druh. What word do you make?
